subject: Parallel micro-loop routing & backup plan for Alex Rivera virtual onsite
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@gmail.com>, Hiring Partner - BrightPath Recruiting <sarah@brightpath.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: Proposed parallel micro-loop for Alex Rivera (virtual onsite)

Hi team —

Following Alex's availability window next week, I sketched a compact parallel micro-loop to keep the day tight while giving each panel the preferred prep buffer. Goal: finish by 5pm PT, allow a 30m debrief block for hiring manager and first-round interviewers. Outline below (all times PT):

- 10:00–10:40 — System Design (Interviewer A)
- 10:45–11:05 — System Design (Interviewer B, concurrent slot overlap for handoff)
- 11:30–12:00 — Coding (Interviewer C)
- 13:00–13:30 — Behavioral + Role Fit (Hiring Manager)
- 14:00–14:30 — Cross-functional deep dive (Interviewer D)
- 16:00–16:30 — Debrief (Hiring Manager + Interviewer leads)

Notes and ask:
- We’ll run two short parallel windows (10:00/10:45) to let Alex pick an earlier or later design slot; we need one backup interviewer for the 10:45 slot in case of last-minute conflict.
- Attach: Alex resume (for quick reference).

Can Marcus and Tessa confirm interviewer assignments and a backup for the 10:45 micro-slot? Also flag any tricky calendar constraints (lunch windows, recruiter overlap).

Thanks,
Monica
---
Monica Patel
Senior Technical Recruiter, Redwood Inference
Attachment: alex_rivera_resume.pdf (pdf)
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposed parallel micro-loop for Alex Rivera (virtual onsite)

Thanks Monica — this looks good and compact. A few sequencing comments:

- Prefer the 10:00 slot for the most senior design interviewer to set context; put the second design interviewer at 10:45 as a focused follow-up.
- Please ensure the 11:30 coding slot has a 10-minute pre-call link check with Alex (we've seen last-minute audio issues).
- For the 14:00 cross-functional deep dive, recommend adding a short 10m pre-brief in calendar for the interviewer to get context from Hiring Manager.

Availability/people:
- I can take the 13:00 Hiring Manager slot.
- Marcus, can you cover the 10:45 design backup if someone needs to swap? If not, can we list Grace O'Connor as on-call?

Also, can Monica attach the interviewer packet and the evaluator rubric once finalized? I’ll sync with Laura after to lock the final openings — we should keep the day resilient to a 20–30m shift.

-Tessa

Tessa Morgan
Engineering Manager, Search Infrastructure
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 11:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposed parallel micro-loop for Alex Rivera (virtual onsite)

I can do the 10:45 slot as backup but note I have a standing sync 11:00–11:15 — I’ll move it for that day. Grace is available as on-call and can swap into the 10:45 if my sync runs long.

Two practical items:
1) If we keep the short overlap between 10:00 and 10:45, please include a 5m overlap buffer in the calendar description so Interviewer B gets context notes and can jump in mid-discussion if needed.
2) For evaluation consistency, use the attached rubric (I’ll leave minor normalization notes in the sheet).

Marcus

Staff Engineer, Serving Runtime
